name_zh: 苏赫巴托尔/乔巴山：游牧转型治理与革命现代化
name_en: Sukhbaatar/Choibalsan: Nomadic Transition Governance & Revolutionary Modernization
description_zh: 达木丁·苏赫巴托尔 (1893-1923) 率领蒙古人民革命党游击队，在苏联红军支持下驱逐白俄/北洋军阀，建立蒙古人民共和国 (1924)；霍尔洛·乔巴山 (1895-1952) 推行集体化/工业化/文化革命，以"苏联模式"强力转型游牧社会。核心张力：游牧自由主义 vs 革命集权现代化；宗教权威 (活佛) vs 党国权威；部落忠诚 vs 阶级忠诚。乔巴山后期修正"左倾"错误，恢复宗教自由、保护游牧生计，体现 M159+M161 游牧契约在现代国家建构中的辩证生存。
description_en: Damdiny Sukhbaatar (1893-1923) led MPRP guerrillas, with Soviet Red Army support expelled White Russians/Beiyang warlords, established Mongolian People's Republic (1924); Khorloogiin Choibalsan (1895-1952) pushed collectivization/industrialization/cultural revolution, forcefully transforming nomadic society via "Soviet model". Core tension: nomadic libertarianism vs revolutionary centralized modernization; religious authority (living Buddha) vs party-state authority; tribal loyalty vs class loyalty. Choibalsan later corrected "leftist" errors, restored religious freedom, protected nomadic livelihoods, exemplifying dialectical survival of M159+M161 nomadic contract in modern state-building.
reason_zh: 蒙古 1921-1990 社会主义实验是游牧文明在现代性冲击下的极限压力测试：如何在保持 M159 游牧共识核心的同时，引入工业化/国家建构/意识形态现代化？苏赫巴托尔建立革命合法性，乔巴山完成国家建构但付出惨痛代价，1990和平民主转型最终回归 M159 契约精神。
reason_en: Mongolia's 1921-1990 socialist experiment was nomadic civilization's extreme stress test under modernity: how to introduce industrialization/state-building/ideological modernization while preserving M159 nomadic consensus core? Sukhbaatar established revolutionary legitimacy, Choibalsan completed state-building at tragic cost, 1990 peaceful democratic transition ultimately returned to M159 contract spirit.
steps_zh: 革命合法性确立：1921年苏赫巴托尔游击战胜利，建立革命政权合法性
国家形式构建：1924年宪法确立人民共和国，废除封建贵族特权
强力现代化推进：乔巴山集体化牧场/建立工业/推行西里尔字母/镇压喇嘛教
错误修正与生存：1932年武装起义后修正左倾，恢复宗教/保护游牧生计
和平民主转型：1990年多党制/市场经济/新宪法，游牧契约精神回归现代治理
steps_en: Revolutionary legitimacy establishment: 1921 Sukhbaatar guerrilla victory, revolutionary regime legitimacy
State form construction: 1924 Constitution establishes People's Republic, abolishes feudal aristocratic privileges
Forced modernization push: Choibalsan collectivizes pastures/builds industry/imposes Cyrillic/suppresses lama Buddhism
Error correction & survival: 1932 armed uprising triggers leftist correction, restores religion/protects nomadic livelihoods
Peaceful democratic transition: 1990 multi-party/market economy/new constitution, nomadic contract spirit returns to modern governance
expected_zh: 游牧文明在革命现代化冲击下经历毁灭性代价，最终以和平转型方式实现 M159 契约精神的现代性重构，为后发国家提供"革命-修正-回归"范式。
expected_en: Nomadic civilization undergoes destructive costs under revolutionary modernity, ultimately achieves modern reconstruction of M159 contract spirit via peaceful transition, providing "revolution-correction-return" paradigm for late-developing nations.
case_zh: 1921年革命胜利→1924年建国→1932年起义修正→1937-39大清洗→1990和平民主转型→1992新宪法，70年实验以 M159 契约精神收束。
case_en: 1921 revolution victory -> 1924 state founded -> 1932 uprising correction -> 1937-39 great purge -> 1990 peaceful democratic transition -> 1992 new constitution, 70-year experiment concludes with M159 contract spirit.
cross_cultural_impact: Only Asian Soviet-style socialist state to peacefully democratize; nomadic socialism case study
resource_curse_mitigation: Soviet aid dependency; post-1990 mineral boom managed via SWF discussions
